top_signals.title: Aramco to Supply Full Oil Volumes to Europe Customers Next Month
top_signals.summary: Saudi Aramco has told European oil refiners it will provide them with all the crude they asked for in November after the kingdom’s key cross-country pipeline resumed operation following attacks, offering relief to customers who’ve been forced to find alternative supplies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Germany pivots away from ECB presidency push
top_signals.summary: Finance minister Lars Klingbeil told colleagues in Luxembourg that Berlin would nominate candidate to succeed executive board member Isabel Schnabel
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Once-in-a-Career Moves Stun Traders in Brazil’s Election Frenzy
top_signals.summary: As Brazilian markets opened for business on Monday, Pradeep Kumar watched a move unfold on his screen that was unlike anything he’d encountered in his two decades trading the country’s assets.
